title: Held calls: a script and a block
summary: Two calls wait for the champion's approval: Cloudflare's own MCP server running a whole script, and Cloudflare Containment blocking one address. Click each to compare.

agents.name: Daring Zinnia
agents.description: Runs investigations, decides what to look at next

approvals.reason: Reads every zone's TLS, HTTPS, WAF and security-level settings, its rulesets and its unproxied DNS records, so the audit can say which zones fall short. It only sends GET requests.

approvals.description: Block an IP address, or an IPv4 /16 or /24 or IPv6 /32, /48 or /64 range, at Cloudflare's edge with an IP Access rule, for the whole account or one zone, and keep a record that Pion made it, which unblock needs.

input.reason: INV-0001: 2,140 blocked logins to the admin panel in 20 minutes.

approvals.reason: 198.51.100.23 sent 2,140 login attempts to admin.example.com in 20 minutes and is a known Lumma stealer panel. Blocking it at the edge for example.com stops the attempts; unblock removes the rule.

messages.text:
**INV-0001 is open: Cloudflare account security audit.** @Daring Zinnia leads.

Check every zone's TLS and WAF settings and anything exposed.
Asking to run one script through Cloudflare that reads every zone's settings, rulesets and DNS records.
198.51.100.23 is hammering admin.example.com: 2,140 blocked logins in 20 minutes. It is a known Lumma stealer panel.
Asking to block 198.51.100.23 for example.com with Cloudflare Containment.
